# AstroSolve

> AstroSolve is a pre-launch platform connecting users in India with astrologers for live
> paid consultations (chat, voice, video), personalised Kundli (Vedic birth chart) readings,
> Kundli matching for marriage, and daily horoscopes in Hindi, English, Tamil, Bengali,
> Telugu, and other Indian languages.

The public website (this site) is currently a pre-launch marketing site: it explains what
AstroSolve is building and collects sign-ups from astrologers who want early access before
the consumer app launches. No live consultations, bookings, or payments happen on this
website itself.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://astrosolve.co/): what AstroSolve is, planned features, and the
  astrologer waitlist sign-up.
- [Blog](https://astrosolve.co/blog/index.html): astrology education content written by
  verified astrologers, covering Vedic astrology fundamentals, Kundli & birth charts, Kundli
  matching, numerology, Vastu Shastra, Tarot, doshas and remedies, and gemstones.
- [Privacy Policy](https://astrosolve.co/privacy-policy.html)
- [Terms of Service](https://astrosolve.co/terms.html)

## Blog

The blog is the primary source of factual astrology content on this site — houses, planets,
dashas, nakshatras, dosha explanations, gemstone guidance, numerology, and Tarot basics.
Each post is written by an in-house astrologer byline and includes a short FAQ section.
Full index and article links: [sitemap.xml](https://astrosolve.co/sitemap.xml).

## Notes for automated use

- This site does not yet have a public API. All product functionality (bookings, chat/voice/
  video consultations, wallet, payments) lives in AstroSolve's mobile app, which is not
  covered by this website.
- Content here is educational/informational, not personalised astrological, medical,
  financial, or legal advice.
- Contact: founder@astrosolve.co
